CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Winter-2025 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Winter-2025 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 1,406 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 5 benchmark sites in 4 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: June 2025 to July 2025). These surveys captured 9 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 19 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 1,758 cards across 138 sites, with 10.5% showing evidence of mouse activity (184 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 450 transects across 119 sites (survey period: June 2025 to August 2025), detecting active burrows in 7.3% of transects (total: 78 active burrows).
